info.description: Wholesale telecom platform API — SIP trunking, numbers, porting, messaging, and billing. All customer endpoints accept an API key (Bearer rk_...) or a session cookie; responses use the {success, data} / {success:false, error:{code,message}} envelope.

get.description: Returns one keyset page of call detail records, newest first. **Pagination is cursor-based**: pass the `next_cursor` from the previous response back as `cursor` to fetch the following page, and stop when `has_more` is false. There is no page number and no total count — an exact total over the CDR store is not affordable at platform volume. Wholesale fields (selected_vendor, vendor_cost, margin, margin_pct, tf_*) are always omitted on this customer endpoint. trunk_id / trunk_name identify the customer's own trunk. Errors: INVALID_DATE, INVALID_CURSOR, CDR_QUERY_FAILED.

parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.
parameters.name: cursor

get.description: Enqueues an asynchronous CSV export of the matching call detail records and returns **202** with a job id — it does NOT stream the file. Poll `GET /v1/cdr/export/jobs/{job_id}` until status is `done`, then download from the returned signed `url` (valid 24h from the moment it is issued; poll again for a fresh one). An export may span at most 93 days, and at most 3 exports per account may be pending or running at once. A file that ends with a TRUNCATED marker line was capped; narrow the date range. Wholesale vendor/cost/margin columns are omitted; Trunk is the customer's own trunk group name. Errors: INVALID_DATE, VALIDATION_ERROR, NO_ACTIVE_CUSTOMER, RATE_LIMITED, CDR_EXPORT_FAILED, CDR_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE.

Returns the state of an export job. While `pending` or `running`, poll again. On `done` the response carries a freshly signed `url` valid until `expires_at` (24h) — the link is minted per request, so an expired one is replaced simply by polling again. On `error`, `error_code` names the failure (including EXPORT_TIMEOUT for a job abandoned mid-run). A job belonging to another customer returns 404. Errors: INVALID_ID, NOT_FOUND, NO_ACTIVE_CUSTOMER, CDR_EXPORT_FAILED, CDR_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE.
get.summary: Poll a CDR CSV export job

get.description: Returns aggregated CDR metrics for a date range. Wholesale economics (total_cost, total_margin, avg_margin_pct) are always omitted on this customer endpoint. `quality` (avg MOS/packet-loss/jitter/PDD + sample count) is present only when the server is reading from the CDR rollup mirror; it is absent (omitted) otherwise. Errors: INVALID_DATE, CDR_QUERY_FAILED.
Returns time-bucketed CDR aggregates for charts. Wholesale total_margin is always omitted on this customer endpoint. Errors: INVALID_DATE, INVALID_GRANULARITY, CDR_QUERY_FAILED.
Returns your prepaid balance and currency. 404 when no active customer is bound to the session. POSTPAID customers see prepaid_balance=0. Errors: NO_ACTIVE_CUSTOMER, NOT_FOUND, INTERNAL_ERROR.

Returns your aggregate CPS/channel capacity and current concurrent usage across trunk groups. counters_available is false (and the current_* fields null) when live counters cannot be read. Errors: NO_ACTIVE_CUSTOMER, INTERNAL_ERROR.
Lists this customer's API keys with their scopes (secrets are never returned — only prefixes). Requires the api_keys:read scope. Errors: FORBIDDEN, INTERNAL_ERROR.
Returns the most recent 100 audit events across ALL of this customer's API keys. Requires the api_keys:read scope. Errors: FORBIDDEN, INTERNAL_ERROR.
Returns one API key's metadata and scopes (never the secret). Requires the api_keys:read scope. Errors: INVALID_ID, NOT_FOUND, INTERNAL_ERROR.
Returns the most recent 100 audit events (create/rotate/revoke/auth activity) for one API key. Requires the api_keys:read scope. Errors: INVALID_ID, NOT_FOUND, INTERNAL_ERROR.

Contacts of the customer's linked HubSpot company, for prefilling team invitations. Returns an empty list when the customer has no HubSpot link or HubSpot integration is not configured — the invite form degrades to free entry. Requires the team:read scope; non-superAdmin callers may only target their own active customer. Errors: INVALID_CUSTOMER_ID, NO_ACTIVE_CUSTOMER, NOT_A_MEMBER, NOT_FOUND.
get.summary: List HubSpot contacts for invite autocomplete

get.description: Lists every unaccepted, unexpired invitation for this customer so the team page can show who has been invited. Requires the team:read scope; non-superAdmin callers may only target their own active customer. Errors: INVALID_CUSTOMER_ID, NO_ACTIVE_CUSTOMER, NOT_A_MEMBER, INTERNAL_ERROR.

delete.description: Revokes a pending invitation issued for this customer so its token can no longer be accepted. Requires the team:write scope; non-superAdmin callers may only target their own active customer, and the invitation must belong to it. Errors: INVALID_CUSTOMER_ID, INVALID_ID, NO_ACTIVE_CUSTOMER, NOT_A_MEMBER, NOT_FOUND.

get.description: Lists every user holding a role in this customer, alphabetical by email. Requires the team:read scope. Errors: FORBIDDEN, INTERNAL_ERROR.

delete.description: Removes a user's membership (role assignment) from this customer and invalidates their sessions. You cannot remove yourself. Requires the team:write scope. Errors: INVALID_USER_ID, VALIDATION_ERROR, INTERNAL_ERROR.

put.description: Assigns a role (system or customer-owned, never superadmin) to a member of this customer. The caller must hold every scope the role grants (no privilege escalation). Requires the team:write scope. Errors: INVALID_USER_ID, INVALID_PAYLOAD, NOT_FOUND, ROLE_MISMATCH, SCOPE_NOT_GRANTABLE, INTERNAL_ERROR.

get.description: Lists the system roles plus this customer's custom roles. Requires the team:read scope. Errors: FORBIDDEN, INTERNAL_ERROR.

post.description: Creates a customer-owned role with the given scope set. Scopes must be in the registry, non-superadmin, and held by the caller (no privilege escalation). Requires the team:write scope. Errors: INVALID_PAYLOAD, SCOPE_NOT_GRANTABLE, CONFLICT, INTERNAL_ERROR.

get.description: Returns one role (system or customer-owned) with its scope list. Requires the team:read scope. Errors: INVALID_ID, NOT_FOUND, INTERNAL_ERROR.

delete.description: Deletes a customer-owned role. Fails when the role is still assigned to any user or is a system role. Requires the team:write scope. Errors: INVALID_ID, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, INTERNAL_ERROR.

patch.description: Updates display name, description, and/or the scope set of a customer-owned role. System roles are immutable. Scope changes fan out session invalidation to affected users. Requires the team:write scope. Errors: INVALID_ID, INVALID_PAYLOAD, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, SCOPE_NOT_GRANTABLE, INTERNAL_ERROR.

post.description: Creates a new customer-owned role copying the source role's scope set (source may be a system role). The caller must hold every copied scope. Requires the team:write scope. Errors: INVALID_ID, INVALID_PAYLOAD, NOT_FOUND, SCOPE_NOT_GRANTABLE, CONFLICT, INTERNAL_ERROR.

post.description:
Sends an outbound SMS from one of your assigned numbers. The
`from` number must be assigned to your account and enrolled in an
approved 10DLC campaign, otherwise the request is rejected.

Supply an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe: a repeated
request with the same key returns the original message with HTTP 200
instead of creating a duplicate (a first successful create returns 201).

Errors: NO_ACTIVE_CUSTOMER, UNAUTHORIZED (401); INVALID_PAYLOAD,
MISSING_PARAM, INVALID_TO (400); FROM_NOT_OWNED (403, the `from`
number is not assigned to your account); CAMPAIGN_NOT_APPROVED (403,
the `from` number is not enrolled in an approved 10DLC campaign);
INTERNAL_ERROR (500).

parameters.description: Client-supplied key that makes retries idempotent
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

get.description: Lists the customer's telephone numbers with voice/SMS configuration state. Filterable by status, type, and configuration flags.

post.description: Procures and assigns up to 200 numbers in one idempotent batch. Requires a UUID Idempotency-Key header (reused as procurement_request_id). Per-TN failures do not abort the batch. Provider sourcing (TNIQ vs Inteliquent) is automatic per TN, following how each number was found in search; a mixed cart is fine. Optional extras — cnam_enabled (inbound caller-name dip; requires a trunk), cnam_display_name (outbound CNAM listing, ≤15 chars, DIDs only), campaign_id (attach to a 10DLC campaign) — apply per successfully assigned TN, best-effort: outcomes land in each result's extras map (keys cnam_dip/cnam_listing/campaign) and never fail the batch. Optional batch voice routing: routing_type trunk|forward|reject (+forward_to_number, forward_preserve_ani); voicemail not yet available. Errors: INVALID_REQUEST, MISSING_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, TRUNK_UNOWNED (whole-request 403 on default_trunk_id).
Assigns up to 200 held numbers to a single voice trunk-group in one request. Idempotent at the SQL level. Errors: INVALID_REQUEST, TRUNK_UNOWNED (whole-request 403).
post.summary: Bulk route numbers to a trunk

get.description: Resolves the active customer's effective monthly rate for a local DID and a toll-free number — plan price (version-pinned) → customer override → list price, the same tiering the Rater bills with. monthly_rate is null when no price is configured at any tier. Errors: NO_ACTIVE_CUSTOMER, INTERNAL_ERROR.
Searches the upstream inventory for purchasable telephone numbers by area code, rate center, locality, or pattern. Returns a paginated list of candidates. Errors: PROVIDER_UPSTREAM_ERROR.
Returns one telephone number with its voice and SMS usage configuration.

patch.description: Updates the friendly name and/or description on an owned number. ASSIGNMENT_BUSY returns 503 with Retry-After. Errors: INVALID_REQUEST, TN_NOT_OWNED.

post.description: Procures a telephone number from inventory and assigns it to the active customer. Idempotent via the Idempotency-Key header. TNIQ-only in v1 — this path has no provider selector; Inteliquent-sourced numbers arrive via search→cart→POST /v1/numbers/bulk-assign (the only UI path that can pick a non-TNIQ provider). Errors: TN_ALREADY_ASSIGNED, TN_UNAVAILABLE, PROVIDER_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

get.description: Reports whether a port-out PIN is set on the number and, when locked out after failed verify attempts, the lock-expiry timestamp. The PIN hash is never returned. Response is bare (no success/data envelope). Errors: TN_NOT_OWNED.

put.description: Sets the customer-chosen 4–10 digit port-out PIN on an owned number (hashed at rest; resets the failed-attempt lock). Requires step-up MFA. Response is bare (no envelope). Errors: INVALID_REQUEST, INVALID_PIN, TN_NOT_OWNED.

delete.description: Clears the port-out PIN on an owned number (idempotent). Requires step-up MFA. Returns 204 No Content on success. Errors: TN_NOT_OWNED.

post.description: Releases a telephone number back to inventory. ASSIGNMENT_BUSY returns 503 with Retry-After; PUBLICATION_UNRESOLVED returns a nonretryable 409. Errors: TN_NOT_OWNED, POI_LOCKED (number is a POI fallback ANI), PROVIDER_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

delete.description: Removes the SMS usage row for an owned number. Errors: TN_NOT_OWNED.

patch.description: Updates the customer-owned SMS fields (inbound webhook URL/secret, fallback URL, MMS toggle) on an owned number. Requests containing tniq-owned fields are rejected. Errors: INVALID_REQUEST, TN_NOT_OWNED.

delete.description: Removes the voice usage row for an owned number, disabling voice routing. ASSIGNMENT_BUSY returns 503 with Retry-After. Errors: TN_NOT_OWNED.

patch.description: Sets or updates voice routing, E911, inbound CNAM dip (cnam_enabled), outbound CNARG listing (cnam_display_name: omit/null=unchanged, empty=clear), and forward routing (forward_to_number + forward_preserve_ani, required when voice_routing_type=forward). ASSIGNMENT_BUSY returns 503 with Retry-After; PUBLICATION_UNRESOLVED returns a nonretryable 409. Errors: INVALID_REQUEST, TN_NOT_OWNED, CNAM_LISTING_NOT_AVAILABLE, TNIQ_ERROR, PROVIDER_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

post.description: Runs an instant Telique-backed portability preview for a free-form list of TNs and groups them by current SPID. tns accepts a comma/space/newline-separated string or an array of TN strings. No project is created. Errors: NO_ACTIVE_CUSTOMER, INVALID_PAYLOAD, VALIDATION_ERROR, GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE.

get.description: Returns the active customer's port-in requests, most-recent first. Each row includes can_resume, a server-derived capability for unsubmitted drafts. Errors: NO_ACTIVE_CUSTOMER, INTERNAL_ERROR.

get.description: Returns the TNIQ validation/port error groups for the project. Errors: NOT_FOUND, TNIQ_ERROR.

monthly_rate_at_assignment.description: Monthly recurring rate captured at the time this number was assigned.

Deliberately wire-visible — the cart/search flow already surfaces it.

Voice-routing summary for list rows; null on single-number reads — use

limit.description:
Limit echoes the page size actually applied after clamping, which may
differ from what the caller asked for.

call_type.description:
CallType is a vestigial pre-Phase-A field; the writer chain stopped
populating it. Kept on the model for legacy consumers but the
frontend renders the "Zone" column from the Zone field below.

codec.description:
Codec is the negotiated customer-leg audio codec (e.g. PCMU, opus)
captured from answer SDP; NULL when not captured.

pdd_ms.description:
PDDMS is true Post-Dial Delay in milliseconds when Option B ms stamps
were captured (start_ms/progress_ms/answer_ms). When only whole-second
stamps exist, ListCDRs falls back to pdd_seconds×1000 — UI shows "N s"
when divisible by 1000 (not sub-second precision).

pdd_seconds.description: PDDSeconds is true PDD in whole seconds: (progress||answer)−start.

ring_seconds.description: RingSeconds is alerting duration (answer−progress). Not PDD.

rtp_packets.description:
Media packet counts (mig 128/129). Total is ingress+egress when both set.
Ingress = customer→WARP; egress = WARP→customer on the customer-labeled leg.

ss_attestation.description:
STIR/SHAKEN provenance. Outbound signing fields are null on
unsigned/legacy calls; inbound verification fields are null on
outbound/legacy calls.

ss_signer.description: Who signed the outbound call's Identity: "warp" (WARP signed it with its own certificate) or "customer" (the caller's own signature was passed through unchanged).

ss_signer_org.description: Organization of the signing certificate's holder: WARP's own certificate when ss_signer is "warp"; for "customer" the holder the certificate CLAIMS, trustworthy only when ss_signer_verstat is "verified".

ss_signer_spc.description: Service Provider Code from the signing certificate: WARP's own when ss_signer is "warp"; for "customer" the code the certificate CLAIMS, trustworthy only when ss_signer_verstat is "verified".

ss_signer_verify_reason.description: Machine reason token behind ss_signer_verstat ("ok" when verified), up to 255 characters.

ss_signer_verstat.description: WARP's record-only check of a customer's signature: "verified", "verification_failed" or "could_not_verify"; null when ss_signer is "warp". Distinct from ss_verstat, the check on calls arriving at WARP.

ss_signer_x5u.description: Address of the signing certificate (https only). Display it as text, never as a link.

tf_cic.description:
Toll-free outbound routing key fields; null except on toll-free
outbound calls.

trunk_id.description:
Customer-facing: which of the CUSTOMER's trunks handled this call.
Distinct from SelectedVendor (WARP's downstream carrier, redacted).
Empty on inbound calls that predate the inbound-trunk capture (PR #164,
then in the since-retired proxy.cfg; b2bua carries the same field).

vendor_cost.description:
Wholesale — customer wire: always redacted by internal/cdrredact.
omitempty so the zeroed values are absent rather than misleading zeros.

zone.description:
Zone is the legacy zone classification (TOLLFREE / INTERSTATE /
INTRASTATE / LOCAL / INTERNATIONAL / etc.) populated by Kamailio +
cdr-drainer. Surfaced to the customer-side CDR table as the Zone
column.

quality.description:
Quality is populated ONLY when CDR_MIRROR_READS is enabled — the mirror
grain (migration 152) carries sum/cnt quality columns the legacy
per-row raw_cdr scan never aggregated. nil on the legacy path; the
frontend falls back to its existing no-quality-data rendering. Never
redacted (customer-visible; internal/cdrredact zeroes fields
individually and does not touch this one).

total_cost.description:
Wholesale economics — customer wire: always redacted by internal/cdrredact.
omitempty so the zeroed values are absent rather than misleading zeros.

capacity_cps_inbound.description:
0 is a valid value: "direction disabled" semantics. Kamailio's per-trunk
runtime gate (warp:tg_cap:<tg_id>:<dir>) treats cap=0 as 503 + Retry-After.
`required` is dropped because validator/v10's `required` rejects zero
values for ints; with this contract a missing field defaults to 0 (a
disabled direction), which is the desired UX for inbound-only trunks.

inbound_dnis_format.description:
InboundDNISFormat governs presentation to the customer; omitted values
are normalized to national by the service layer.

options_ping_enabled.description: OptionsPingEnabled defaults to true when omitted on create.

amount.description: Amount is signed, matching ledger convention: negative = charge.

events.description: Events is the number of ledger rows behind this line.

is_usage.description:
IsUsage distinguishes a rated SKU from money-in, so the UI can present
charges and credits differently without string-matching the label.

quantity.description:
Quantity/Unit are populated for usage-based lines; null for money-in
rows (payments, credits, adjustments).

sku_code.description: SKUCode is the billing SKU, or the txn_type for money-in rows.

charge_total.description:
ChargeTotal is the sum of negative lines only, which is the denominator
the composition bar proportions against. Summing signed amounts would let
a payment shrink the bar and misstate every share.

net_amount.description: NetAmount is the signed sum of every line — the period's balance movement.

trunk_groups.description: never null; empty array when no trunks reference this number

total_margin.description: Wholesale — customer wire: always redacted by internal/cdrredact.

capacity_cps_inbound.description:
SP10.7.0: split into directional capacity. Inbound = WARP→Customer;
outbound = Customer→WARP.

options_ping_enabled.description:
When true (default), WARP periodically health-checks this trunk's
inbound endpoints and skips unhealthy ones. Set false if your SBC does
not answer SIP OPTIONS, so it stays selectable regardless of probe result.

poi_assignment_id.description:
Trunk-level override for the Place-of-Interconnection fallback caller
ID. Null means this trunk inherits the customer-level POI. Admin-only.

poi_number.description: Resolved details of the number backing PoiAssignmentID, when set.

ss_signing_mode.description:
STIR/SHAKEN per-trunk signing policy. Admin-only. Null means WARP
applies its default policy (sign / attest B / validate).

outbound = Customer→WARP.

capacity_cps_inbound.description: 0 = direction disabled. See CreateTrunkGroupRequest for runtime semantics.

options_ping_enabled.description: Omitted means no change. Customer self-service.

poi_assignment_id.description:
Trunk-level POI fallback override. Omitted means no change; explicit
null clears the override back to the customer-level POI.

ss_signing_mode.description:
STIR/SHAKEN per-trunk signing policy. Admin-only. Allowed values:
ss_signing_mode ∈ {off,sign}, ss_attest_fallback ∈ {B,C},
ss_existing_header_policy ∈ {validate,passthrough,override}. Omitted
means no change.

difficulty.description:
Difficulty is a WARP-side EASY/MEDIUM/HARD rating reflecting TCR
approval friction.

min_samples.description:
MinSamples is the WARP-recommended minimum number of sample
messages for this use case, tuned to maximize approval chance.

forward_to_number.description: Destination number or SIP URI used when voice_routing_type is "forward".

name.description: Normalized published CNAM; must remain nonempty and satisfy CNAM normalization.

cnam_listing_operation_id.description:
CNAMListingOperationID is the durable number-operation that publishes
the batch's cnam_display_name, set by the handler when the listing was
queued (TNs then carry extras.cnam_listing="queued"). Progress is at
GET /v1/number-operations/{id}; per-TN outcomes at .../{id}/items.

extras.description:
Extras carries per-option outcomes of the OPTIONAL post-procurement
extras (cnam_dip / cnam_listing / campaign), populated by the HANDLER
layer after BulkAssign returns, and of the service's own post-procurement
voice write (voice_routing). Extras are best-effort: an extras failure
never changes Status.

provider.description:
Provider identifies which upstream returned this candidate: "TNIQ" or
a fallback provider's Key() (e.g. "INTELIQUENT"). Explicit beats
implicit on the wire — set on every result, including primary-path
TNIQ hits.

reservation_status.description: "spare" — DID inventory and TFN search-spare both browse without reserving; nothing here is pre-reserved

message.description: "EIN lookup match found" or "No match found"

applicationId.description:
ApplicationID/ApplicationMetadata: omitempty is load-bearing. tniq's
updateBrand is otherwise full-replace, but these two fields are
null-safe on update as of v2.169.0 (ringer-soa 5f5f9b2d) — absent means
"no change", NOT "clear". There is no verified way to clear a binding
via this endpoint (sending JSON null was considered and rejected by the
upstream fix; omission and null are both treated as no-op).

ApplicationID/ApplicationMetadata: omitempty is load-bearing. tniq's
updateCampaign is otherwise full-replace, but these two fields are
null-safe on update as of v2.169.0 (ringer-soa 5f5f9b2d) — absent means
"no change", NOT "clear". There is no verified way to clear a binding
via this endpoint (explicit JSON null is indistinguishable from
omission on this DTO and is likewise treated as no-op).

account_number.description: Sensitive — present in TNIQ responses today (ringer-tniq#153); never log.

cnam_enabled.description:
Optional post-procurement extras, applied per successfully assigned TN
(best-effort; outcomes in each result's extras map, never failing the
batch). CNAMEnabled turns on the inbound caller-name dip (requires the
TN to be routed to a trunk — trunkless TNs report skipped_no_trunk).
CNAMDisplayName sets one outbound CNARG listing name (≤15 chars A–Z,
0–9, spaces; DIDs only) on every TN in the batch.
CampaignID attaches all assigned TNs to that 10DLC messaging campaign.

provider_by_tn.description:
ProviderByTN routes each TN to the DID provider that should fulfill it
("TNIQ" | "INTELIQUENT"); missing/empty entries default to TNIQ.
Sourcing is automatic from the cart the customer built via search — a
caller-spoofed key is harmless: the wrong vendor simply doesn't have
that TN in its own inventory, so the order fails per-TN rather than
misattributing cost.

routing_type.description:
RoutingType selects batch-level voice routing: "trunk" (default when
trunk fields are present), "forward", or "reject". Voicemail is not
yet available and 400s. Forward and reject ignore trunk fields.

monthly_rate.description: null = no price configured at any tier

applies its default policy (sign / attest B / validate).

ForwardToNumber / ForwardPreserveANI configure voice_routing_type=forward.
An empty string on ForwardToNumber leaves the value unchanged — there
is no "clear the forward target" wire affordance here; switch
voice_routing_type away from "forward" instead.

available_forms.description:
AvailableForms carries the fillable form schema(s) the frontend declares for
the current page so the fill_page_form tool can validate the model's proposed
values. Capped server-side (buzz.ClampForms) before it reaches the engine.

reason.description:
Reason is the per-TN failure reason: not_found, not_owned, lookup_error,
or write_error.

phone_numbers.description: PhoneNumbers is the list of telephone numbers to attach or detach.

body.description:
Body is the message text. Encoding (GSM-7 vs UCS-2) and segment count are
computed automatically from the content.

from.description:
From is the sending telephone number. Must be a number assigned to your
account AND enrolled in an approved 10DLC campaign. NANP format, e.g.
"13039813633".

status_callback.description:
StatusCallback is recorded against the message but is NOT yet delivered
to: nothing posts message-status webhooks to it today. Poll
GET /v1/messages/{id} for status. Inbound-message webhooks are a separate,
working feature configured per telephone number.

to.description:
To is the destination telephone number in E.164 / NANP format, e.g.
"13125551212".

tcr_brand_id.description: TCRBrandID is the TCR brand ID to link into this account.

tcr_campaign_id.description: TCRCampaignID is the TCR campaign ID to link into this account.

name.description: Normalized published CNAM; must remain nonempty and satisfy CNAM normalization.
